Name: Level Extender
Author: unidarkshin
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Level Extender[/size][/b]
[size=5]Extend your skills to Level 100 and beyond![/size][/center][center][b][color=#90EE90]This mod has been fully updated for Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+.[/color][/b]
This is the official maintained version of the original mod by [url=https://github.com/unidarkshin]unidarkshin[/url]. It is now maintained by [url=https://github.com/F1r3w477]F1r3w477[/url].[/center]
[size=6][b]What This Mod Does[/b][/size]
Level Extender is a configurable mod that removes the vanilla level 10 skill cap, allowing you to level all five core skills up to level 100+. As you gain levels, you'll see tangible benefits, such as a higher chance to find extra items, an easier time fishing, and more. The mod is highly configurable through in-game console commands.

[b][size=6]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Extend All 5 Skills:[/b] Go beyond level 10 up to level 100 (and beyond!).
[*] [b]On-Screen XP Bars:[/b] An optional UI element appears when you gain experience to track your progress.
[*] [b]Item Duplication:[/b] As your skill levels increase, you gain a chance to acquire extra items (e.g., duplicate fish, ore, or foraged goods).
[*] [b]Enhanced Fishing:[/b] The fishing bobber bar becomes larger at higher skill levels, making fishing easier. Fish difficulty is also randomized based on your level.
[*] [b]Overworld Monster Spawning:[/b] Optionally spawn tougher monsters on your farm that scale with your combat level.
[*] [b]Full Configuration:[/b] All features can be toggled and configured on the fly using console commands.
[*][b]Extended Skills Menu:[/b] Default Shift + K (Configurable)
[/list]
[size=6][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*] Download this mod and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
[*] Run the game using SMAPI!
[/list]
[size=6][b][left]﻿[b]Configuration[/b][/left][/b][/size]This mod is configured entirely through SMAPI console commands. There is no `config.json` file. See the list of commands below to customize the mod to your liking.

[center][size=6][b]Console Commands[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*] [b]le_xp[/b]
[b]Description:[/b] Displays the XP table for your current skill levels. [b]Example:[/b] [b]le_xp[/b][*] [b]le_setlevel[/b]
[b]Description:[/b] Sets a skill to a specific level. [b]Example:[/b] [b]le_setlevel Fishing 25[/b][*] [b]le_setxp[/b]
[b]Description:[/b] Sets the raw experience points for a skill. [b]Example:[/b] [b]le_setxp Mining 20000[/b][*] [b]le_xp_table[/b]
[b]Description:[/b] Displays the full XP table for a specific skill. [b]Example:[/b] [b]le_xp_table Mining[/b][*] [b]le_toggle_xpbars[/b]
[b]Description:[/b] Toggles the on-screen XP bars. (Default: true) [b]Example: le_toggle_xpbars[/b][*] [b]le_toggle_monsters[/b]
[b]Description:[/b] Toggles the overworld monster spawning feature. (Default: false) [b]Example:[/b] [b]le_toggle_monsters[/b][*] [b]le_xp_modifier[/b]
[b]Description:[/b] Changes the XP modifier for a [b]specific skill[/b]. Must restart game. [b]Example:[/b] [b]le_xp_modifier Farming 1.5[/b][*] [b]le_toggle_notifications[/b]
[b]Description:[/b] Toggles the "extra item notification" pop-ups. [b]Example:[/b] [b]le_toggle_notifications[/b][*] [b]le_min_notification_price[/b]
[b]Description:[/b] Sets the minimum gold value for an item to show a notification. [b]Example:[/b] [b]le_min_notification_price 100[/b][/list]
[size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
This mod should be compatible with most other SMAPI mods. It may conflict with other mods that fundamentally change how skill experience is gained.
[b][color=#FFD700]Important Note:[/color][/b] The compatibility with "All Professions" or "Skill Prestige" mods from pre-1.6 is no longer supported and will not work.

[size=6][b]Bug Reports & Source Code[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] Please report any bugs on the [b][url=https://github.com/F1r3w477/Level-Extender/issues]GitHub Issues page[/url][/b].
[*] The source code is available on [url=https://github.com/F1r3w477/Level-Extender]GitHub[/url].
[/list]
